title: Image Prompts
description: Per-page prompt frontmatter (prompts/NN-slide-{slug}.md) and deck-wide images_manifest.json. Prompts use YAML frontmatter plus markdown body; manifest tracks path, backend, and generation status per slide.

Backend.description: Image generation backend id. Use 'none' only for staged prompts when no backend is available. v1 core tier is native/openai/gemini/nanobanana (Google Gemini Image API); other values are extended providers.

PromptFrontmatter.title: Per-page Image Prompt frontmatter
PromptFrontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter at top of prompts/NN-slide-{slug}.md. Markdown body below frontmatter contains the full Prompt text sent to the image backend.

filename.description: This prompt file's own basename, for self-reference

visible_text.description: Text that MUST literally appear in the generated image. Keep minimal — image models are unreliable with long text.

visual_composition.description: Free-form description of layout, visual hierarchy, focal point, elements, mood. The bulk of the actual prompt narrative.

style_lock_ref.description: Relative path to style_lock.json used when this prompt was authored. Usually 'source/style_lock.json'. Image Renderer must re-read this before any (re)generation.

negative_constraints.description: What MUST NOT appear: 'no slide numbers', 'no logos', 'no watermarks', 'no photographic faces', plus deck-level forbidden[] echoes.

reference_image.description: Optional path to an anchor image (e.g. cover.png) for visual consistency across the deck.

session_id.description: Optional backend session id when the backend supports multi-shot consistency.

generated_image_path.description: Where the resulting raster should be written. Convention: 'images/slide-NN.png'. Empty string allowed when prompt is staged but not yet generated.

Manifest.title: Deck-wide images manifest
Manifest.description: JSON object at <project>/images_manifest.json. One entry per slide with image_requirement.needed=true. Image Renderer uses this for batch generation, regenerate workflows, and Producer delivery checks.

prompt_file.description: Relative path to the per-page prompt file, e.g. 'prompts/01-slide-cover.md'

image_file.description: Relative path to the generated raster, e.g. 'images/slide-01.png'. Empty string when status='pending' or 'needs-manual'.

status.description: pending = prompt staged, no backend call yet; generating = in-flight; ok = file present; failed = backend error (see error); needs-manual = backend gave up but should not block delivery; regenerate-requested = scheduled for regenerate workflow.

error.description: Backend error message when status='failed' or 'needs-manual'.

attempts.description: How many backend calls have been made for this entry.
